# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2020

**Resolution No. 024, Series of 2020**

An appropriation ordinance adopting the Bayanihan Grant to the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]], equivalent to one month Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) for FY 2020 in the amount of P7,751,722.00, subsidy from the [[Provincial Government of Quezon]] of P100,000.00, and savings from the 20% Development Fund (2018 and 2019) in the amount of P5,722,392.48 — for a total of P13,574,114.48 — to provide basic services due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

## Summary

This emergency appropriation ordinance was enacted on April 13, 2020, in response to the [[COVID-19]] pandemic. It consolidates three funding sources to provide basic services to the residents of [[Pitogo]]:

1. **Bayanihan Grant** equivalent to one month IRA for FY 2020: **P7,751,722.00**
2. **Provincial Government Subsidy**: **P100,000.00**
3. **Savings from 20% Development Fund** (CY 2018 and CY 2019): **P5,722,392.48**

The total appropriation amounts to **P13,574,114.48**, allocated to provide basic services and pandemic response.

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** Adoption of the Bayanihan Grant equivalent to one month IRA for FY 2020 amounting to P7,751,722.00.
- **Section 2.** Inclusion of provincial government subsidy of P100,000.00.
- **Section 3.** Utilization of savings from the 20% Development Fund from CY 2018 and CY 2019 amounting to P5,722,392.48.
- **Section 4.** Total appropriation of P13,574,114.48 for basic services during the COVID-19 pandemic.
- **Section 5.** Effectivity upon approval.
